name: SleekFin
description: The ultimate Jellyfin Web revamp, with new elements, styles, plus compatible with the most popular plugins.
overview: The ultimate Jellyfin Web revamp, with new elements, styles, plus compatible with the most popular plugins.

versions.changelog: Stopped the background container from covering video playback
Fixed help link to go to correct github link

Reorganized the frontend into compact Preact modules, seperated js/css files each for different elements, removed redundant runtime logic, and made it so frontend bundles are generated through the .NET build

Finished the complete UI redesign with a global black and red theme, shared icons and reusable UI components, responsive media rows with enriched metadata, redesigned Movie, Series, Season, and Episode detail pages with full-page backdrop heroes, refactored home hero controls, updated Readme, SleekFin branding and icons
Added a css fix to jellyfin's top padding problem where the hero would start a bit lower than it was supposed to
Added full-width hero section at the top of home page with customizable content sources, fixed manifest
Update active controls logic for better navigation. This is the first published release due to the branch being "master" instead of "main" for some reason.
Updated header logic to use href of links instead of specific paths, so SeerrFin/JE links work
Added a custom header bar putting the server logo on the left and all tabs and the rest in a navbar on the right
